title: Day 80: CNN Exposes CIA Ground Branch Lethal Anti-Cartel Operations in Mexico — García Harfuch Denies; El Sapo Hunt Enters Day 80; 29 Days to FIFA World Cup
detail: Day 80 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CIA-MEXICO EXPLOSIVE REVELATION (May 12–13, 2026): CNN published a major exclusive on May 12 reporting that CIA Ground Branch operatives have directly participated in lethal anti-cartel operations inside Mexico over the past year — including a March 2026 targeted assassination on a Mexican highway of Francisco Beltran ('El Payin'), a mid-level Sinaloa Cartel operative, and operations destroying six drug labs in Chihuahua. The CNN report remained a developing story through May 13, representing the most significant public revelation of direct U.S. intelligence involvement in lethal cartel targeting operations on Mexican soil. Mexico's Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch issued a categorical denial; the CIA also denied the report. The revelation arrives at maximum bilateral stress: all five active bilateral pressure tracks remain open simultaneously — (1) CIA Chihuahua sovereignty deadlock (Maru Campos declined April 28 Senate hearing); (2) DOJ SDNY indictment of Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya + 9 officials (at 'temporary leave' since May 2); (3) Sheinbaum's 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard (May 6); (4) U.S. State Dept review of 53 Mexican consulates (May 7–8); (5) ongoing CJNG interdiction framework. The CNN story directly intersects with this tracker's context because the bilateral enforcement environment — including the CIA-linked Chihuahua labs operation and the overall post-El Mencho counter-cartel campaign — enabled the conditions under which the Tapalpa operation occurred. Sheinbaum's sovereignty framing ('Mexico does not accept foreign operations on its soil') remains the administration's formal position as of Day 80. U.S.-Mexico joint anti-cartel operations continue in practice despite the diplomatic framing, per Latin Post (May 12). The National Drug Control Strategy 2026 (released May 4) formally designates CJNG and Sinaloa Cartel as Foreign Terrorist Organizations and classifies fentanyl precursors as weapons of mass destruction — the strategic framework underpinning the CIA-adjacent operations reported by CNN. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 80: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target (named May 3). Day 80 with no confirmed capture or elimination — as El Sapo maintains active control of CJNG sicario recruitment networks in Jalisco, Michoacán, and Puebla. His personal security detail includes former Mexican Army, Marines, and Colombian and Guatemalan former combatants, making capture operations high-risk. POST-EL CHUCKY MANZANILLO VOID (Day 4): Four days after Lorenzo Sánchez 'El Chucky' was arrested May 9, the Port of Manzanillo's CJNG plaza command structure remains in transition with no publicly identified successor. El 03's Grupo Élite is assessed as working toward designating a replacement within the 1–2 week window identified by analysts. Embedded port relationships (corrupted customs officials, dock workers, shipping intermediaries) remain structurally intact. PLAN KUKULKAN — 29 DAYS: Mexico's FIFA World Cup 2026 security strategy now 29 days from the June 11 opening match. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, CJNG's historic operational base) hosts 4 group-stage matches; Mexico's 130,000-person nationwide security deployment continues. ACLED ASSESSMENT REMAINS VALID: The May 12 ACLED finding of zero CJNG fracture 79 days post-Mencho — 'tactical containment' and Michoacán alliance reinforcement with Los Viagras — continues to define the succession dynamic as El 03 consolidates. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 80: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27, vinculado a proceso Altiplano May 4), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza boss (arrested May 9). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained.

media.caption: CNN exclusive: CIA Ground Branch operatives participated in lethal anti-cartel operations inside Mexico, including a March 2026 highway killing — García Harfuch and CIA both deny report
Mexico formally rejects CNN report of CIA lethal operations — sovereignty crisis deepens as all five bilateral pressure tracks remain active on Day 80
